description: Connect to Model Context Protocol servers (STDIO / HTTP / SSE) and expose their tools to the Health Assistant chat. Server processes run out-of-band (T3): they open their own network connections outside this app's SSRF perimeter; the app governs what they return (per-tool allowlist, result caps, audited calls).
